description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Wayward Disciple
